factProposals.value: The Command Center is a static page served from the repo, so it cannot hold a secret: it cannot call an AI model or check an integration itself.
Whether Microsoft, Google Workspace, CRM and MCP are connected cannot be determined from the repo; every system shows as not checked until the running system reports.
Two must-have requirements have no fulfilling story: REQ-002 (CRM and ticketing) and REQ-011 (MCP servers). Should-haves REQ-016, REQ-017 and REQ-018 have none either.
A proposed data model of 20 tables derived from the requirements, including an append-only, hash-chained AuditEvent table for REQ-008. Not yet created.

decisions.statement: Build the Command Center as a static site with no build step, entered from index.html at the repo root.
decisions.rationale: GitHub Pages serves only the root or docs/, and docs/ is rewritten by the platform on every sync.

decisions.statement: Read every tab's content from .colaberry/ at runtime through one loader.
decisions.rationale: The files are rewritten on each sync; a typed-out copy would go stale.

decisions.statement: Answer Knowledge base questions by fixed rules over page data, with no AI model.
decisions.rationale: A public static page cannot hold an API key; rules can cite their source and refuse what they cannot answer.

decisions.statement: Ship a .nojekyll file at the repo root.
decisions.rationale: GitHub Pages otherwise skips dot-folders, so .colaberry/ would not be served.

decisions.statement: Default to Real mode; Sample must be switched on and is bannered on every screen.
decisions.rationale: Nobody should demo sample data by accident.

limitations.statement: The question panel only answers questions that match its rules; anything else gets an explicit cannot-answer reply.
The AI agents tab lists story owners, labelled as owners, because plan.agents is empty.
All data is as of the last sync (manifest.generated_at); nothing on the page is live.
Points are shown exactly as progress.json reports them, with a note when no story is verified yet.
